23016-T1
SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3601-11 West Cortland Street / 1844-56 North Central Park Avenue
From RM-5 to RM-5
The Property
The subject property is an improved property located in a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District. The property is improved
with a five-story with basement building that previously included a transitional residence use, The building’s existing
height is 64.42’.

The Project
KDP CHICAGO CORTLAND LLC (the “‘Applicant”) will convert the existing building to residential use with 42 units and
34 parking spaces. The building’s existing height will remain. A four story addition with a height of 59.83’ is proposed.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RM-S Residential Multi-Unit District to a RM-S Residential Multi-Unit
District to seek all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1 application under section
17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation per section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the minimum required front
setback (Central Park Avenue) required under section 17-2-0305 from 15.0’ to 0; 2) an optional variation per section 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the minimum required north side setback (Cortland Avenue) required under section 17-2-0309 from to
0; 3) an optional variation per section 17-13-1[01-B to reduce the required combined side setback to zero; 4) an
optional variation per section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required south side setback (alley) required under section 17-2-
0309 from to 0; 5) an optional variation per section {7-13-1101-D to reduce the off-street parking requirement under
section 17-10-0207-C by 20% from 42 spaces to 34 spaces; _ 6) an optional variation per section 17-13-110t-D to reduce
the off-street loading space requirement under section 17-10-1100 from one loading space to zero; 7) an optional
variation per sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-K to reduce the required amount of rear yard open space required
under section 17-2-0307 . to zero; 8) an optional variation per sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-L to allow a
building height of 59.83’ which exceeds the maximum allowable height required under section 17-2-0311 of 47.0” but is
not more than the existing non-conforming building height of 64.42’; 9) an optional variation per sections 17-13-1101-A.
and | 7-13-1003-II to seek relief under the Landscape Ordinance to reduce interior landscape area required under section
17-11-0203-B from 580 square feet to 256 square feet, and 10) an optional variation per section | 7-13-1101-A and
17-13-1003-II to reduce interior trees required under section 17-11-0203-B from 5 to 0.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 16,892 square feet

FAR: 2.00

Floor Area: 33,784 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 42

MLA Density: 402 square feet

Height: 64.42’ (existing height of building)
59.83’ (proposed building addition height)*

Automobile Parking: 34*

Loading Berths: oF

Setbacks (existing): Front (Central Park Avenue): o*
North Side (Cortland Avenue): o*
South Side (alley): o*

Rear: 56°
